about_short_description.short_description: Burgan Bank is a commercial bank that offers financial and asset management services.

product.name: Personal Banking
product.description: Banking services for individuals, including current and savings accounts, deposits, personal finance, and everyday money management.

product.name: Corporate and Commercial Banking
product.description: Financial services for businesses, including operating accounts, business lending, working-capital finance, and relationship banking.

product.name: Credit Cards and Payment Cards
product.description: Debit and credit cards for purchases, cash access, and electronic payments through merchant and ATM networks.

product.name: Personal Finance and Consumer Lending
product.description: Consumer credit facilities for personal needs such as major purchases, expenses, and other approved financial requirements.

product.name: Trade Finance
product.description: Banking instruments that support domestic and international trade, including documentary credits, guarantees, and collection services.

product.name: Cash Management and Transaction Banking
product.description: Services that help businesses collect, pay, reconcile, and control operating cash through banking accounts and electronic channels.
